prompt: What are the version coordinates for this project's Gatling line?
why: The two references are cut along the Gatling/Galaxio axis so that a coordinate question loads one of them. A build file with no `org.galaxio` in it has no Galaxio question to answer, and opening the Galaxio file anyway is the cut failing while every link check stays green. The package path is still `org/galaxio/performance` — the layout invariant mandates it — so the case also asks whether a package path is told apart from a dependency coordinate.

prompt: Which gatling-picatinny release goes with this project?
why: The same cut in the other direction. Picatinny is a Galaxio coordinate, so the answer is one file — reaching for the Gatling table too means the dispatch is loading both whatever is asked.

prompt: Which gatling-maven-plugin release goes with Gatling 3.16?
why: 3.16 is above the last column. The table has to answer with the lookup rather than extrapolating the 3.14/3.15 cell upward — a stored answer for a line nobody has measured is how the matrix goes stale. Bash is withheld, so running the lookup is impossible and naming it is the whole assertion.

prompt: Which Gatling line is this project on?
why: The POM carries `gatling-maven-plugin 4.21.10` beside `gatling.version 3.11.5`, and the build plugin numbers independently. `4.21.10` is the wrong answer this routing exists to prevent, and it is what `galaxio-gatling-pro` stopped explaining in its own body — so this case is what proves the deletion left the rule reachable.
